Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: The app must allow users to individually select and display current football news of their favorite team from preferred sports channels.
Metrics.explanation: FR-002 covers displaying current football news for favorite teams, and FR-003 covers individually selecting preferred sports channels for news display. Together they capture the full meaning of the source requirement.

Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: The app must allow users to view live results of their favorite teams in real time via a live ticker.
Metrics.explanation: FR-004 states that the system provides a live ticker for favorite teams, and FR-009 explicitly adds real-time retrieval and display of live results for users' favorite teams through the live ticker module. Combined they fully cover the requirement.

Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: The app must allow users to view league tables and statistics from current as well as past seasons.
Metrics.explanation: No generated requirement explicitly mentions league tables, statistics, or access to current and past seasons. FR-005 discusses coverage of leagues and competitions, but not tables, statistics, or historical season data.

Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: The app must provide users with detailed team and player information that can be accessed at any time.
Metrics.explanation: FR-006 directly states that the system must provide detailed team and player information and that it is available at any time, fully matching the source requirement.

Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: As soon as a live match begins the app must allow users to access live stream links from providers such as DAZN or Sky as long as the broadcast rights are valid.
Metrics.explanation: FR-007 covers access to live stream links from providers such as DAZN or Sky when the live broadcast has begun, and FR-008 captures the constraint that links are shown only when rights are valid in the user's country. Together they fully match the original requirement.

Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: The app must allow users to register easily and log in directly from the start page.
Metrics.explanation: FR-014 covers allowing users to register and log in directly at app startup. The nuance of 'easily' is only indirectly reflected through the startup flow and is not strongly specified, but the core functional meaning is captured.

Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: The app must allow users to personalize their experience by following their favorite teams and leagues.
Metrics.explanation: FR-015 covers personalizing the experience by following favorite clubs/teams, but it omits following favorite leagues. Since the source explicitly requires both teams and leagues, the generated requirement only partially captures the meaning.

Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: The app must allow users to select favorite teams and national teams to receive push notifications about news and updates.
Metrics.explanation: The generated set includes FR-016 for notifications about favorite teams and FR-015 for following favorite clubs, but there is no requirement covering selection of national teams, nor an explicit combined requirement about choosing favorite teams and national teams specifically for push notifications about news and updates.

Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: The app must allow users to receive push notifications about news or results of their favorite teams.
Metrics.explanation: FR-016 directly states that users can receive notifications about news or results of their favorite teams, which fully captures the original requirement.

Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: The app must allow users to share news and match reports directly via social media.
Metrics.explanation: FR-017 directly covers sharing news and game/match reports via social media directly from the app, fully matching the source requirement.

Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: The live ticker module must allow users to retrieve and display live data.
Metrics.explanation: FR-009 states that the system provides real-time retrieval and display of live results via the integrated live ticker module, and FR-011 adds retrieval of live data from an external API. Although FR-009 focuses on live results rather than generic 'live data,' the core retrieval and display behavior of the live ticker module is captured.

Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: The app must allow users to access live match results through the user interface directly.
Metrics.explanation: FR-009 covers access to live match/live results, and FR-010 specifies that the live ticker module communicates with the user interface to display continuously updated match data. Together they capture direct access to live match results through the UI, though the wording is somewhat more technical than the source.

Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: The user interface must allow users to view and manage content and modules together.
Metrics.explanation: FR-012 addresses additional modules that let users individually configure the app through the user interface, but it does not clearly state that users can view and manage content and modules together. The content-management-together aspect is missing.

Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: The registration system must allow the registration process to be carried out quickly and easily.
Metrics.explanation: FR-014 states that users can register and log in directly at app startup, but it does not explicitly capture the quality constraint that registration must be quick and easy. The functional area overlaps, but the usability requirement is not fully preserved.

Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: The notification system must allow the app to send users information about current events once activated.
Metrics.explanation: FR-013 directly states that when activated by the user, the notification function delivers information about current events, fully matching the source requirement.
